title: Kissed Juicy Polish Pork Skillet
description: A winey and juicy Polish dish featuring massaman curry paste and a mirepoix base, cooked to perfection in a paella pan.
instructions: Heat a large paella pan over medium high heat and add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the pork to the pan and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the massaman curry paste to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the red wine and chicken broth to the pan and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the pork is tender, about 20 minutes.
Season the pork with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the pork hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
